import Mathlib

/-! QIK-VRT: exact finite-state lower bounds. All capacities are in natural
numbers; no real logarithm or floating point is needed. Theorems quantify
explicitly over encoders and observability contracts, not native hardware. -/

namespace QIKVRT.MetaTransistor

open scoped BigOperators

abbrev CellWord (q n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin q

@[simp] theorem card_cellWord (q n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (CellWord q n) = q ^ n := by
  simp [CellWord, Fintype.card_fun]

theorem canonical_storage_injective {H S : Type*} (encode : H → S)
    (decode : S → H) (h : Function.LeftInverse decode encode) :
    Function.Injective encode := h.injective

theorem state_capacity_lower_bound {H : Type*} [Fintype H]
    {q n : ℕ} (encode : H → CellWord q n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    Fintype.card H ≤ q ^ n := by
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective encode h

theorem word_capacity_lower_bound {a m q n : ℕ}
    (encode : CellWord a m → CellWord q n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    a ^ m ≤ q ^ n := by
  simpa using state_capacity_lower_bound encode h

/-- Exact counterpart of ceil(log_q R), for q ≥ 2. -/
theorem capacity_exists (q R : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) : ∃ n : ℕ, R ≤ q ^ n := by
  have h : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 ^ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      have hp : 0 < (2 : ℕ) ^ k := pow_pos (by decide) _
      rw [pow_succ]
      omega
  exact ⟨R, (h R).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hq R)⟩

noncomputable def minCells (q R : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) : ℕ :=
  Nat.find (capacity_exists q R hq)

theorem minCells_sufficient (q R : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    R ≤ q ^ minCells q R hq := Nat.find_spec (capacity_exists q R hq)

theorem minCells_necessary {q R n : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (h : R ≤ q ^ n) :
    minCells q R hq ≤ n := Nat.find_min' (capacity_exists q R hq) h

theorem minCells_iff {q R n : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    minCells q R hq ≤ n ↔ R ≤ q ^ n := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (minCells_sufficient q R hq).trans
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) h)
  · exact minCells_necessary hq

theorem exact_cell_lower_bound {H : Type*} [Fintype H] {q n : ℕ}
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (encode : H → CellWord q n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    minCells q (Fintype.card H) hq ≤ n :=
  minCells_necessary hq (state_capacity_lower_bound encode h)

theorem binary_exponent_bound {B C : ℕ} (h : (2 : ℕ) ^ B ≤ 2 ^ C) : B ≤ C := by
  by_contra hn
  have hlt : C < B := by omega
  exact (not_lt_of_ge h) (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by decide) hlt)

theorem binary_cell_capacity {B b n : ℕ} (h : (2 : ℕ)^B ≤ (2^b)^n) :
    B ≤ b*n := by
  apply binary_exponent_bound
  simpa only [pow_mul] using h

/-- The exact division-free statement equivalent to n ≥ ceil(B/b) for b>0. -/
theorem binary_state_lower_bound {B b n : ℕ}
    (encode : CellWord 2 B → CellWord (2^b) n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    B ≤ b*n := binary_cell_capacity (word_capacity_lower_bound encode h)

/-- No free input-to-output bypass: a nonconstant operation is carried by cells. -/
theorem active_cell_lower_bound {q n : ℕ} (encode : Fin 2 → CellWord q n)
    (out : CellWord q n → Fin 2) (h : Function.LeftInverse out encode) : 1 ≤ n := by
  have hc := state_capacity_lower_bound encode h.injective
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hc
  by_contra hn
  have hz : n = 0 := by omega
  simp [hz] at hc

/-- Register-only contract: all 544 bits are independently observable. -/
def cpuRegisterBits : ℕ := 8*32 + 7*32 + 2*32

theorem cpu_register_bits : cpuRegisterBits = 544 := by decide

theorem cpu_register_lower_bound {b n : ℕ}
    (encode : CellWord 2 cpuRegisterBits → CellWord (2^b) n)
    (h : Function.Injective encode) : 544 ≤ b*n := by
  simpa [cpuRegisterBits] using binary_state_lower_bound encode h

theorem sequencer_lower_bound {b n : ℕ}
    (encode : Fin 5 → CellWord (2^b) n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    3 ≤ b*n := by
  have hc : 5 ≤ (2^b)^n := by simpa using state_capacity_lower_bound encode h
  rw [← pow_mul] at hc
  by_contra hn
  have hh : b*n ≤ 2 := by omega
  have hp : (2 : ℕ)^(b*n) ≤ 2^2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hh
  norm_num at hp
  omega

/-! Moore and Mealy lower bounds via distinguishable prefixes. A suffix
match means the last |w| symbols, not an absorbing substring detector. -/
def SuffixMatch (w xs : List Bool) : Prop := ∃ p : List Bool, xs = p ++ w

theorem suffix_length {w xs : List Bool} (h : SuffixMatch w xs) : w.length ≤ xs.length := by
  rcases h with ⟨p, hp⟩
  rw [hp, List.length_append]
  omega

theorem prefix_hit (w : List Bool) (j : ℕ) : SuffixMatch w (w.take j ++ w.drop j) := by
  exact ⟨[], by simpa using List.take_append_drop j w⟩

theorem shorter_prefix_misses (w : List Bool) {i j : ℕ}
    (hij : i < j) (hj : j ≤ w.length) :
    ¬ SuffixMatch w (w.take i ++ w.drop j) := by
  intro h
  have hl := suffix_length h
  rw [List.length_append, List.length_take, List.length_drop] at hl
  rw [Nat.min_eq_left (by omega : i ≤ w.length)] at hl
  omega

/-- `allowEmpty` distinguishes Moore observations (including the current
output) from a Mealy last-output observation after a nonempty continuation. -/
theorem prefix_states_injective {Q : Type*} (w : List Bool) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k ≤ w.length + 1) (allowEmpty : Bool)
    (allowed : ∀ j : Fin k, j.val < w.length ∨ allowEmpty = true)
    (state : List Bool → Q) (observe : Q → List Bool → Prop)
    (correct : ∀ u v : List Bool, (v ≠ [] ∨ allowEmpty = true) →
      (observe (state u) v ↔ SuffixMatch w (u ++ v))) :
    Function.Injective (fun j : Fin k => state (w.take j.val)) := by
  have sep : ∀ i j : Fin k, i.val < j.val →
      state (w.take i.val) ≠ state (w.take j.val) := by
    intro i j hij heq
    have hj : j.val ≤ w.length := by have := j.isLt; omega
    have hv : w.drop j.val ≠ [] ∨ allowEmpty = true := by
      rcases allowed j with hlt | he
      · left
        intro hz
        have hl := congrArg List.length hz
        simp only [List.length_drop, List.length_nil] at hl
        omega
      · exact Or.inr he
    have hhit := (correct (w.take j.val) (w.drop j.val) hv).2 (prefix_hit w j.val)
    have hobs : observe (state (w.take i.val)) (w.drop j.val) := by
      rw [heq]
      exact hhit
    exact shorter_prefix_misses w hij hj
      ((correct (w.take i.val) (w.drop j.val) hv).1 hobs)
  intro i j heq
  apply Fin.ext
  rcases lt_trichotomy i.val j.val with h | h | h
  · exact False.elim (sep i j h heq)
  · exact h
  · exact False.elim (sep j i h heq.symm)

structure Moore (Q : Type*) where
  init : Q
  step : Q → Bool → Q
  hit : Q → Bool

def Moore.run {Q : Type*} (M : Moore Q) (s : Q) (xs : List Bool) : Q :=
  xs.foldl M.step s

theorem Moore.run_append {Q : Type*} (M : Moore Q) (s : Q) (u v : List Bool) :
    M.run s (u ++ v) = M.run (M.run s u) v := by
  simp [Moore.run, List.foldl_append]

theorem mesh_recognizer_minimality {Q : Type*} [Fintype Q]
    (M : Moore Q) (w : List Bool)
    (correct : ∀ xs, M.hit (M.run M.init xs) = true ↔ SuffixMatch w xs) :
    w.length + 1 ≤ Fintype.card Q := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun j : Fin (w.length+1) => M.run M.init (w.take j.val)) :=
    prefix_states_injective w (w.length+1) (by omega) true
      (fun _ => Or.inr rfl) (M.run M.init) (fun s v => M.hit (M.run s v) = true)
      (by intro u v _; rw [← M.run_append]; exact correct (u ++ v))
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hinj

structure Mealy (Q : Type*) where
  init : Q
  step : Q → Bool → Q
  hit : Q → Bool → Bool

def Mealy.run {Q : Type*} (M : Mealy Q) (s : Q) (xs : List Bool) : Q := xs.foldl M.step s

def Mealy.lastHit {Q : Type*} (M : Mealy Q) : Q → List Bool → Bool
  | _, [] => false
  | s, x :: xs => if xs = [] then M.hit s x else M.lastHit (M.step s x) xs

theorem Mealy.lastHit_append {Q : Type*} (M : Mealy Q) (s : Q)
    (u v : List Bool) (hv : v ≠ []) :
    M.lastHit s (u ++ v) = M.lastHit (M.run s u) v := by
  induction u generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hn : xs ++ v ≠ [] := by
      intro he
      have hl := congrArg List.length he
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_nil] at hl
      have hz : v.length = 0 := by omega
      exact hv (by cases v with | nil => rfl | cons a t => simp at hz)
    simp only [List.cons_append, Mealy.lastHit, if_neg hn, Mealy.run, List.foldl_cons]
    exact ih (M.step s x)

theorem mealy_recognizer_lower_bound {Q : Type*} [Fintype Q]
    (M : Mealy Q) (w : List Bool)
    (correct : ∀ xs, xs ≠ [] → (M.lastHit M.init xs = true ↔ SuffixMatch w xs)) :
    w.length ≤ Fintype.card Q := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun j : Fin w.length => M.run M.init (w.take j.val)) := by
    apply prefix_states_injective w w.length (by omega) false
      (fun j => Or.inl j.isLt) (M.run M.init) (fun s v => M.lastHit s v = true)
    intro u v hv
    have hn : v ≠ [] := by simpa using hv
    have huv : u ++ v ≠ [] := by
      intro he
      have hl := congrArg List.length he
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_nil] at hl
      have hz : v.length = 0 := by omega
      exact hn (by cases v with | nil => rfl | cons a t => simp at hz)
    rw [← M.lastHit_append M.init u v hn]
    exact correct (u ++ v) huv
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hinj

theorem mesh_moore_binary_lower_bound {b n : ℕ}
    (M : Moore (CellWord (2^b) n)) (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = 3200)
    (correct : ∀ xs, M.hit (M.run M.init xs) = true ↔ SuffixMatch w xs) :
    12 ≤ b*n := by
  have h : 3201 ≤ (2^b)^n := by simpa [hw] using mesh_recognizer_minimality M w correct
  rw [← pow_mul] at h
  by_contra hn
  have hp : (2 : ℕ)^(b*n) ≤ 2^11 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
  norm_num at hp
  omega

theorem mesh_mealy_binary_lower_bound {b n : ℕ}
    (M : Mealy (CellWord (2^b) n)) (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = 3200)
    (correct : ∀ xs, xs ≠ [] → (M.lastHit M.init xs = true ↔ SuffixMatch w xs)) :
    12 ≤ b*n := by
  have h : 3200 ≤ (2^b)^n := by simpa [hw] using mealy_recognizer_lower_bound M w correct
  rw [← pow_mul] at h
  by_contra hn
  have hp : (2 : ℕ)^(b*n) ≤ 2^11 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
  norm_num at hp
  omega

theorem mesh_register_width_exact : (2 : ℕ)^11 < 3201 ∧ 3201 ≤ 2^12 := by norm_num

theorem mealy_register_width_exact : (2 : ℕ)^11 < 3200 ∧ 3200 ≤ 2^12 := by norm_num

/-- Both recognizer states must be independently and jointly observable. -/
theorem bidirectional_product_bound {q n : ℕ}
    (encode : Fin 3201 × Fin 3201 → CellWord q n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    3201^2 ≤ q^n := by
  simpa [Fintype.card_prod, pow_two] using state_capacity_lower_bound encode h

theorem bidirectional_binary_lower_bound {b n : ℕ}
    (encode : Fin 3201 × Fin 3201 → CellWord (2^b) n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    24 ≤ b*n := by
  have hc := bidirectional_product_bound encode h
  rw [← pow_mul] at hc
  by_contra hn
  have hp : (2 : ℕ)^(b*n) ≤ 2^23 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
  norm_num at hp hc
  omega

/-! Persistent data, EAP, EMP and restart state. -/
theorem persistent_history_lower_bound {H : Type*} [Fintype H] {q n : ℕ}
    (encode : H → CellWord q n) (decode : CellWord q n → H)
    (h : Function.LeftInverse decode encode) : Fintype.card H ≤ q^n :=
  state_capacity_lower_bound encode h.injective

theorem arbitrary_byte_storage_lower_bound {P b n : ℕ}
    (encode : CellWord 256 P → CellWord (2^b) n)
    (h : Function.Injective encode) : 8*P ≤ b*n := by
  have hc := word_capacity_lower_bound encode h
  change (2^8 : ℕ)^P ≤ (2^b)^n at hc
  apply binary_cell_capacity
  simpa only [pow_mul] using hc

/-- A deterministic second representation adds no independent states. -/
def canonicalPairEquiv {H S : Type*} (derive : H → S) :
    H ≃ {p : H × S // p.2 = derive p.1} where
  toFun h := ⟨(h, derive h), rfl⟩
  invFun p := p.val.1
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext rfl p.property.symm

theorem canonical_pair_card {H S : Type*} [Fintype H] [Fintype S]
    (derive : H → S) [DecidablePred (fun p : H × S => p.2 = derive p.1)] :
    Fintype.card {p : H × S // p.2 = derive p.1} = Fintype.card H :=
  (Fintype.card_congr (canonicalPairEquiv derive)).symm

theorem eap_state_lower_bound {a m q n : ℕ}
    (encode : (Fin m → Fin a) → CellWord q n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    a^m ≤ q^n := word_capacity_lower_bound encode h

theorem eap_binary_lower_bound {m b n : ℕ}
    (encode : CellWord 2 m → CellWord (2^b) n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    m ≤ b*n := binary_state_lower_bound encode h

theorem emp_history_lower_bound {m q n : ℕ}
    (encode : Equiv.Perm (Fin m) → CellWord q n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    m.factorial ≤ q^n := by
  simpa [Fintype.card_perm] using state_capacity_lower_bound encode h

/-- Elementary factorial estimate, avoids Stirling and real logarithms. -/
theorem factorial_block_lower (s t : ℕ) : (s+1)^t ≤ (s+t).factorial := by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    simp only [pow_zero, Nat.add_zero]
    exact Nat.factorial_pos s
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [Nat.add_succ, Nat.factorial_succ, pow_succ]
    calc
      (s+1)^t * (s+1) ≤ (s+t).factorial * (s+t+1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul ih (by omega)
      _ = (s+t+1) * (s+t).factorial := Nat.mul_comm _ _

theorem emp_logarithmic_block_lower {s t ell b n : ℕ}
    (hbase : (2 : ℕ)^ell ≤ s+1)
    (encode : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s+t)) → CellWord (2^b) n)
    (h : Function.Injective encode) : ell*t ≤ b*n := by
  have hp := (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hbase t).trans
    ((factorial_block_lower s t).trans (emp_history_lower_bound encode h))
  apply binary_cell_capacity
  simpa only [pow_mul] using hp

theorem fencing_epoch_lower_bound {e q n : ℕ}
    (encode : Fin e → CellWord q n) (h : Function.Injective encode) : e ≤ q^n := by
  simpa using state_capacity_lower_bound encode h

theorem no_unbounded_epochs (q n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ e : ℕ, ∃ encode : Fin e → CellWord q n, Function.Injective encode) : False := by
  obtain ⟨encode, he⟩ := h (q^n + 1)
  have hc := fencing_epoch_lower_bound encode he
  omega

theorem optimizer_space_lower_bound {d q n : ℕ} (a : Fin d → ℕ)
    (encode : ((j : Fin d) → Fin (a j)) → CellWord q n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    (∏ j, a j) ≤ q^n := by
  classical
  simpa [Fintype.card_pi] using state_capacity_lower_bound encode h

theorem optimizer_linear_lower_bound {a d b n : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a)
    (encode : CellWord a d → CellWord (2^b) n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    d ≤ b*n := binary_cell_capacity ((Nat.pow_le_pow_left ha d).trans
      (word_capacity_lower_bound encode h))

theorem optimizer_uniform_bits_lower_bound {c d b n : ℕ}
    (encode : CellWord (2^c) d → CellWord (2^b) n) (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    c*d ≤ b*n := by
  apply binary_cell_capacity
  simpa only [pow_mul] using word_capacity_lower_bound encode h

/-- Nonuniform axes: every axis has at least two possible restart positions. -/
theorem optimizer_variable_axes_linear_lower_bound {d b n : ℕ}
    (a : Fin d → ℕ) (ha : ∀ j, 2 ≤ a j)
    (encode : ((j : Fin d) → Fin (a j)) → CellWord (2^b) n)
    (h : Function.Injective encode) : d ≤ b*n := by
  let embed : CellWord 2 d → ((j : Fin d) → Fin (a j)) :=
    fun x j => ⟨(x j).val, lt_of_lt_of_le (x j).isLt (ha j)⟩
  have he : Function.Injective embed := by
    intro x y hxy
    funext j
    apply Fin.ext
    exact congrArg Fin.val (congrFun hxy j)
  exact binary_state_lower_bound (encode ∘ embed) (h.comp he)

/-! Fault bounds. A known erasure pattern or a corrupt coordinate is a
physical cell, not a logical record. No external recovery oracle is free. -/
def prefixProjection {q n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ n) (x : CellWord q n) : CellWord q r :=
  fun i => x ⟨i.val, lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hr⟩

theorem erasure_tolerance_lower_bound {H : Type*} [Fintype H] {q n f : ℕ}
    (hf : f ≤ n) (encode : H → CellWord q n)
    (recover : CellWord q (n-f) → H)
    (correct : Function.LeftInverse recover (prefixProjection (n-f) (by omega) ∘ encode)) :
    Fintype.card H ≤ q^(n-f) := state_capacity_lower_bound _ correct.injective

theorem erasure_cell_count_lower_bound {H : Type*} [Fintype H] {q n f : ℕ}
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ n) (encode : H → CellWord q n)
    (recover : CellWord q (n-f) → H)
    (correct : Function.LeftInverse recover (prefixProjection (n-f) (by omega) ∘ encode)) :
    f + minCells q (Fintype.card H) hq ≤ n := by
  have hc := minCells_necessary hq (erasure_tolerance_lower_bound hf encode recover correct)
  omega

/-- At most f altered coordinates, specified by f optional slots. Repeated
slots are allowed. This is equivalent to support cardinality ≤ f. -/
def Within {q n : ℕ} (f : ℕ) (x y : CellWord q n) : Prop :=
  ∃ slots : Fin f → Option (Fin n),
    ∀ i : Fin n, (∀ j, slots j ≠ some i) → x i = y i

def blockSlots (n f start : ℕ) (j : Fin f) : Option (Fin n) :=
  if h : start + j.val < n then some ⟨start+j.val, h⟩ else none

theorem blockSlots_covers {n f start : ℕ} (i : Fin n)
    (hlo : start ≤ i.val) (hhi : i.val < start+f) :
    ∃ j : Fin f, blockSlots n f start j = some i := by
  let j : Fin f := ⟨i.val-start, by omega⟩
  have he : start+j.val = i.val := by dsimp [j]; omega
  have hh : start+j.val < n := by rw [he]; exact i.isLt
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  rw [blockSlots, dif_pos hh]
  exact congrArg some (Fin.ext he)

/-- Puncture the last 2f cells. If two messages agree on the prefix, a
hybrid word lies within f changes of each, contradicting unique recovery. -/
theorem error_correction_capacity {H : Type*} [Fintype H] {q n f : ℕ}
    (encode : H → CellWord q n) (decode : CellWord q n → H)
    (correct : ∀ h y, Within f (encode h) y → decode y = h) :
    Fintype.card H ≤ q^(n-2*f) := by
  let r := n-2*f
  let project : H → CellWord q r := prefixProjection r (by dsimp [r]; omega) ∘ encode
  apply state_capacity_lower_bound project
  intro x y he
  let z : CellWord q n := fun i => if i.val < r+f then encode x i else encode y i
  have hx : Within f (encode x) z := by
    refine ⟨blockSlots n f (r+f), ?_⟩
    intro i hnot
    have hi : i.val < r+f := by
      by_contra hh
      have hlo : r+f ≤ i.val := by omega
      have hhi : i.val < r+f+f := by dsimp [r] at *; have := i.isLt; omega
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := blockSlots_covers i hlo hhi
      exact hnot j hj
    simp [z, hi]
  have hy : Within f (encode y) z := by
    refine ⟨blockSlots n f r, ?_⟩
    intro i hnot
    by_cases hi : i.val < r+f
    · have hir : i.val < r := by
        by_contra hh
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := blockSlots_covers i (show r ≤ i.val by omega) hi
        exact hnot j hj
      have hp := congrFun he ⟨i.val, hir⟩
      have hxy : encode x i = encode y i := hp
      simp [z, hi, hxy]
    · simp [z, hi]
  exact (correct x z hx).symm.trans (correct y z hy)

theorem error_correction_cell_count_lower_bound {H : Type*} [Fintype H]
    {q n f : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hH : 2 ≤ Fintype.card H)
    (encode : H → CellWord q n) (decode : CellWord q n → H)
    (correct : ∀ h y, Within f (encode h) y → decode y = h) :
    2*f + minCells q (Fintype.card H) hq ≤ n := by
  have hc := error_correction_capacity encode decode correct
  have hf : 2*f ≤ n := by
    by_contra hh
    have hz : n-2*f = 0 := by omega
    simp [hz] at hc
    omega
  have hm := minCells_necessary hq hc
  omega

/-! Fan-in. Reverse topological cone expansion is a concrete certificate:
start from one output, expand one frontier gate at a time. A DAG certificate
must expand each relevant physical gate at most once and cover the inputs. -/
inductive FrontierTrace {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V] (r : ℕ) (root : V) :
    ℕ → Finset V → Prop
  | base : FrontierTrace r root 0 {root}
  | step {n s} (prev : FrontierTrace r root n s) (v : V) (args : Finset V)
      (hv : v ∈ s) (ha : args.card ≤ r) :
      FrontierTrace r root (n+1) (s.erase v ∪ args)

theorem frontier_card_bound {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V] {r : ℕ} {root : V}
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) {n : ℕ} {s : Finset V} (trace : FrontierTrace r root n s) :
    s.card ≤ 1+n*(r-1) := by
  induction trace with
  | base => simp
  | @step n s prev v args hv ha ih =>
    have hu := Finset.card_union_le (s.erase v) args
    have he := Finset.card_erase_add_one hv
    rw [Nat.add_mul]
    omega

theorem bounded_fanin_lower_bound {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V] {r N t : ℕ}
    {root : V} {frontier inputs : Finset V} (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (trace : FrontierTrace r root t frontier) (ht : t ≤ N)
    (covers : inputs ⊆ frontier) : inputs.card ≤ 1+N*(r-1) := by
  exact (Finset.card_le_card covers).trans
    ((frontier_card_bound (by omega) trace).trans
      (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (r-1) ht) 1))

/-! Combining bounds. Separate encoders do not imply an injective product.
The joint theorem requires an explicit simultaneous-state encoder. -/
theorem separate_state_space_lower_bound {ι : Type*} {q n : ℕ}
    (R : ι → ℕ) (encode : ∀ i, Fin (R i) → CellWord q n)
    (h : ∀ i, Function.Injective (encode i)) : ∀ i, R i ≤ q^n := by
  intro i
  simpa using state_capacity_lower_bound (encode i) (h i)

theorem conservative_max_lower_bound {ι : Type*} {q n : ℕ}
    (I : Finset ι) (R : ι → ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q)
    (encode : ∀ i, Fin (R i) → CellWord q n)
    (h : ∀ i, Function.Injective (encode i)) :
    I.sup (fun i => minCells q (R i) hq) ≤ n := by
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro i _
  exact minCells_necessary hq (separate_state_space_lower_bound R encode h i)

theorem joint_state_space_lower_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {q n : ℕ}
    (R : ι → ℕ) (encode : ((i : ι) → Fin (R i)) → CellWord q n)
    (h : Function.Injective encode) : (∏ i, R i) ≤ q^n := by
  classical
  simpa [Fintype.card_pi] using state_capacity_lower_bound encode h

theorem joint_binary_state_lower_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {b n : ℕ}
    (B : ι → ℕ) (encode : ((i : ι) → Fin (2^(B i))) → CellWord (2^b) n)
    (h : Function.Injective encode) : (∑ i, B i) ≤ b*n := by
  classical
  have hp := joint_state_space_lower_bound (fun i => 2^(B i)) encode h
  have hpow : (∏ i, (2 : ℕ)^(B i)) = 2^(∑ i, B i) := by
    exact Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum Finset.univ B 2
  rw [hpow] at hp
  exact binary_cell_capacity hp

/-- Joint independent model, not a claim that the native protocol states
are independent. P is bytes, m EAP effects, k freely ordered EMP effects,
e epochs, and axes are the restart parameter cardinalities. -/
abbrev JointQIKState (P m a k e d : ℕ) (axes : Fin d → ℕ) :=
  CellWord 2 544 × (Fin 3201 × Fin 3201) × CellWord 256 P ×
  CellWord a m × Equiv.Perm (Fin k) × Fin e × ((j : Fin d) → Fin (axes j))

theorem qik_combined_capacity {P m a k e d q n : ℕ} (axes : Fin d → ℕ)
    (encode : JointQIKState P m a k e d axes → CellWord q n)
    (h : Function.Injective encode) :
    2^544 * (3201^2 * (256^P * (a^m * (k.factorial * (e * (∏ j, axes j)))))) ≤ q^n := by
  classical
  simpa [JointQIKState, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_pi, pow_two]
    using state_capacity_lower_bound encode h

/-- A finite closed system cannot losslessly encode arbitrary-length bit strings. -/
theorem unbounded_history_impossibility (q n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ P : ℕ, ∃ encode : CellWord 2 P → CellWord q n, Function.Injective encode) : False := by
  obtain ⟨encode, he⟩ := h (q^n+1)
  have hc := word_capacity_lower_bound encode he
  have hpow : ∀ k : ℕ, k < (2 : ℕ)^k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => decide
    | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ]; omega
  have hh := hpow (q^n+1)
  omega

theorem mesh_minCells_exact : minCells 2 3201 (by decide) = 12 := by
  have hu : minCells 2 3201 (by decide) ≤ 12 := minCells_necessary (by decide) (by norm_num)
  have hc := minCells_sufficient 2 3201 (by decide)
  by_contra hn
  have hlt : minCells 2 3201 (by decide) ≤ 11 := by omega
  have hp : (2 : ℕ)^(minCells 2 3201 (by decide)) ≤ 2^11 :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hlt
  norm_num at hp
  omega

theorem bidirectional_minCells_exact : minCells 2 (3201^2) (by decide) = 24 := by
  have hu : minCells 2 (3201^2) (by decide) ≤ 24 := minCells_necessary (by decide) (by norm_num)
  have hc := minCells_sufficient 2 (3201^2) (by decide)
  by_contra hn
  have hlt : minCells 2 (3201^2) (by decide) ≤ 23 := by omega
  have hp : (2 : ℕ)^(minCells 2 (3201^2) (by decide)) ≤ 2^23 :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hlt
  have hnum : (3201 : ℕ)^2 = 10246401 := by norm_num
  have hconst : (2 : ℕ)^23 = 8388608 := by norm_num
  rw [hconst] at hp
  have hc' : 10246401 ≤ 2^(minCells 2 (3201^2) (by decide)) := by
    calc
      10246401 = (3201 : ℕ)^2 := hnum.symm
      _ ≤ _ := hc
  omega

end QIKVRT.MetaTransistor
